text: Fang's mum fell on the ice and broke her wrist in two places, surgery Thursday morning at 8. Fang's driving up the night before and staying the week to look after her, her dad can't really cope on his own since his hip. She sounded pretty frazzled. Remind me to text her that afternoon to see how it went
Ayo is 30 weeks now!! baby shower on the 14th at 2pm at her sister Kiri's place
new manager starts monday, apparently called Graham, ex Deloitte. everyone's a bit wary
Jun - client call w/ the Bianchi account moved to Wed 10am. he's presenting, quite nervous about it

So I was chatting to Paolo after standup and he said his little girl's been in hospital since Saturday with a chest infection, they're hoping she'll be home by the weekend. He's working from home the rest of the week. I should drop him a message Friday evening to check how she's doing
Ignacio and Camila's christening for baby Fiona is Sunday 11am, St Mary's, lunch at the Crown afterwards
pick up prescription before 6, pharmacy shuts early on tues
Anan's dad had a mini stroke last week. Doing ok but Anan is really struggling, been off work since
remind me to ask carlos how the appraisal went, it was today at 4
Mabel told me she's expecting! due in March. hasn't told work yet so keep it quiet. she's craving pickled onions lol
bao - coeliac, also hates coriander. remember for the team lunch
Graham's leaving do was meant to be Fri but it's been called off, his wife's poorly. Might rearrange for Dec
Lwazi tore his ACL at five a side. op is on the 3rd at half 8 in the morning, then 6 weeks on crutches. Need to pop round a week after with some snacks and the Switch
Florin's wife Elena had the baby!! little boy, Milan, 7lb 2. born yesterday at 4am. send congrats + chip in for the group gift

Ryan says his boss Pieter is impossible at the moment, rewrote his whole deck the night before the board meeting and then blamed him when the numbers didn't match. Ryan's looking around quietly, has a chat with a recruiter Friday at 12. He's also doing a project management course in the evenings
Kiri's son has chickenpox so she's off till Weds
Gustavo mentioned his dog Biscuit is having a lump removed tomorrow morning. he's a bit anxious about it. text him in the afternoon
Aarav got the promotion! Head of client services from January. Celebrating drinks Thursday after work

Okay voice note. Rana rang, her mum's had a fall at home, nothing broken but they're keeping her in overnight for observation. Rana's going in tomorrow morning first thing, and her brother Milan is flying back from Dubai on Saturday. Need to call Rana on Sunday to check in, and maybe drop off some food the day before Milan arrives so she's not cooking

Kavya - 20 week scan Tuesday at 9:15, she and Patrick find out the gender. They're doing a reveal at her parents' the weekend after, cake and everything. She said the morning sickness has finally eased off. Patrick's already painted the nursery yellow just in case. I should get them a little something for the reveal, she mentioned they still need a baby monitor
don't forget Fiona's back from mat leave on the 2nd. get her a welcome back card
Malik's been signed off with stress for two weeks. Didn't want anyone at work to know
Chidi just started at Nowak & Partners, junior architect, loves it so far
zoe's baby's christening sunday, the 19th, 12 noon. Need to buy a gift before then, maybe a silver bangle
dentist thurs at 3:40. dont be late again
Miriam's daughter Eva has glandular fever, missed a month of school. Miriam is shattered, juggling it with the new job
Elena's due date was yesterday, nothing yet. She's fed up and uncomfortable. text her tomorrow morning
Pieter Osei from the Shah Group account wants a site visit, Fri 21st at 2pm, and a follow up call the Monday after
Hemi broke his collarbone mountain biking. Hes a keen cyclist so being off the bike is killing him
Fang - loves Korean dramas, currently watching something with ghosts. Reads a lot of sci fi too

So Ayo's partner Chidi called to say the baby arrived early, 35 weeks, a little girl called Zoe. They're both fine but she's in special care for a few days just to be safe. Ayo is exhausted but really happy. Chidi said visitors from next week. Maybe take a lasagne round
Jun said his mum's knee replacement went well yesterday, she's already walking with a frame
remind me to email Paolo the client brief tonight before 8, he needs it for the 9am pitch
Ignacio retiring end of the month after 22 years. Do for him on the 28th at 5:30. Need to sign the card and chip in
Anan's back at work tomorrow. Be nice
Carlos was at the hospital this morning with his son, suspected appendicitis. Turned out it was fine, just a stomach bug
Mabel's baby shower was cancelled, she's on bed rest now. high blood pressure. text her this weekend
Bao n his wife Kiri expecting twins!!! told me at lunch. first scan was last wk
Graham - mentioned his daughter Camila is graduating med school in July, he's so proud
call vet about the cat's jabs, then book MOT for next week
Lwazi wants one of those posh coffee machines for his birthday apparently, the Sage one. hinted at it twice
Rough call with Florin. His dad's been diagnosed with Parkinson's. Appointment with the specialist on the 9th, Florin is going with him. Remind me to ring him that evening
Ryan and Zoe's daughter starts nursery next Monday, mornings only. Zoe's dreading drop off

um so Gustavo has the big presentation to the Baker client on Thursday at 11am and he is honestly petrified, he's been rehearsing it every lunchtime. his manager Fiona is coming along too which isn't helping. message him good luck the night before and then maybe take him for a pint afterwards
Aarav's wife Kavya had a miscarriage last month. He told me today. Just be gentle with him
note to self - Rana's on a work trip to Lisbon from the 5th to the 9th, then off for a week afterwards
Kavya's mum is in for a hip op on Friday the 17th, 7am. Kavya taking the day off. ask her how it went the Monday after
Patrick's new boss, Mrs Brennan, sounds lovely. he's settling in well
Fi (Fiona) said the baby's teething and no one's slept in a week. she's a zombie
Me and Malik have the client offsite in Leeds Wednesday, leaving at 7am. I'm driving

So Chidi was telling me about his sister Miriam, she's pregnant with her third and they've only just moved house, like two weeks ago. She's due in about six weeks and the nursery isn't even painted. He's going down this weekend to help out. I said I'd ask how the move's settling. Remind me to message Miriam next week, and send something for the baby when it comes
Eva has a job interview at the hospital on Tuesday at 10, physio role. Feeling quite confident

Elena's off sick again, migraines. third time this month. Her manager Malik pulled me aside to ask if I knew whats going on, I said no. She told me last week she's got a neuro appointment on the 30th at 2:15 but she's worried they'll find nothing. Don't forget to check in with her the day after
Milan from accounts is the one with the allergy to nuts, not Malik. sort out the order
Hemi and his partner Rana got engaged at the weekend! wedding probably next summer
Uncle Pat's having his cataract op on the 22nd at half 1. Mum's taking him. call him the next day
Fang's cat Mochi went missing on Sunday night. Still not back. She's beside herself
Ayo mentioned her dad is in remission! All clear at the scan last week

Long chat with Jun Mensah in the kitchen. Apparently the restructure is going ahead in Jan and his whole team is being merged with Paolo's. Jun has a consultation meeting on the 8th at 3pm and he's convinced he's getting made redundant. Wife's pregnant too so the timing couldn't be worse. Must check in with him the day after the meeting
weekly shop, bins out tonight, and finish the quarterly report by Friday at 5
